import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

describe('a callback', () => {
  it('ends in a return', () => {
    const values = [1, 2, 3].map((value) => {
      const doubled = value * 2;
      return doubled;
    });
    const filtered = values.filter((value) => {
      if (value > 2) {
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    });
    const run = () => {
      expect(filtered).toHaveLength(2);
      return filtered;
    };
    expect(run()).toEqual([4, 6]);
  });
});
